title: Before the Dragons

idea.logline: The history of the known world before House Targaryen, from the Dawn Age to the Doom of Valyria.
idea.audience: YouTube Shorts and Reels viewers who like dense narrated history
idea.notes: Vertical 9:16. One narration line per clip, 18-22 words. Original writing only - no source text is quoted.

styleLock: Live-action, cinematic, filmed in vertical 9:16 framing, desaturated cold color grade with deep blacks, heavy volumetric haze, handheld-stabilized documentary realism, shallow depth of field.
voiceLock: narrator with a deep, gravelly, slow-paced voice and a neutral British accent (S1)

scenes.shot: Low angle on a marching legion in bronze scale and tall shields, spears rising and falling in perfect unison, dust boiling around their feet.

episodes.title: Fourteen Flames
episodes.era: Valyrian shepherds discover dragons; the Freehold is born
episodes.hookOut: Ghis had legions. Valyria had dragons.

scenes.vo: Valyria had no kings. It had families, forty of them, and every one of them owned dragons.
scenes.shot: Aerial through cloud onto a peninsula of black volcanic mountains ringed by white marble towers, dragons circling the peaks like birds.

scenes.vo: They learned to bind a dragon to a rider while both were young, and they never shared how.
scenes.shot: A young rider in scaled armour walks slowly toward a chained hatchling in a torchlit pit, one hand extended, saying nothing.

scenes.vo: They kept the bloodline inside the family, because they believed the fire was in the blood.
scenes.shot: A formal marriage rite in a mirrored marble hall; a silver-haired pair of near-identical appearance stand facing each other before robed witnesses.

scenes.vo: Beneath their cities, chained men cut the mountains open so the sorcerers could work the flame.
scenes.shot: Descending shot down a shaft into a glowing mine: chained figures with picks working ledges above open magma, overseers on the rim.

scenes.vo: With fire and spells they folded steel that would never dull and never break.
scenes.shot: Extreme close-up of a smith folding a rippling dark blade in a furnace as another figure speaks over it in a low unbroken chant.

scenes.vo: They laid straight black roads across a continent, and the roads never cracked.
scenes.shot: Low aerial skimming along a perfectly straight fused-stone road running dead straight over hills to the horizon.

scenes.vo: In two hundred years they went from herding goats to owning the largest empire men had ever built.
scenes.shot: Time-lapse-style push out from a single stone hut to a vast marble city sprawling across the volcanic slopes.

scenes.vo: Only one power stood in their way. It had been standing there for five thousand years.
scenes.shot: Cut to the walls of Ghis at dusk; sentries turn to look west as a shadow crosses the sun above them.
scenes.textCard: PART 5 — FIVE WARS, ONE ASH FIELD

episodes.title: Five Wars, One Ash Field
episodes.era: The Ghiscari wars; Ghis burned and sown with salt
episodes.hookOut: Nothing now stood between Valyria and the world.

scenes.vo: Ghis and Valyria fought five wars. Ghis won none of them.
scenes.shot: Split-horizon wide: a legion in perfect formation on a plain, and above the ridge behind them, three dragons rising.

scenes.vo: The legions did everything correctly. That was the problem — they stood in ranks.
scenes.shot: Ground-level in the shield wall as officers dress the line; men lock shields and brace, eyes on the sky rather than the front.

scenes.vo: Ranks are hard to break with cavalry. They are very easy to burn.
scenes.shot: A wall of dragonfire rolls the length of the formation; shields blacken and men scatter as the line disintegrates.

scenes.vo: War after war, the empire shrank. Cities changed hands, then changed shape.
scenes.shot: Aerial over a burned coastal city, its brick pyramids slumped and glassy, smoke drifting over an empty harbour.

scenes.vo: In the fifth war Valyria stopped taking territory and started removing it.
scenes.shot: Night raid: repeated fire passes over a walled city, each pass leaving a wider ring of flame until the walls glow.

scenes.vo: They burned Ghis to the ground, tore down what was left, and ploughed the ruin under.
scenes.shot: Dawn over the ruin field: teams of chained labourers dragging ploughs through ash and broken brick where a city stood.

scenes.vo: Then they sowed the fields with salt, so that nothing would grow there again.
scenes.shot: Close on hands scattering coarse white salt into black ash; camera pulls back to reveal the scale of the dead ground.

scenes.vo: The oldest empire in the world ended in a single afternoon. Nothing now stood between Valyria and everything else.
scenes.shot: Slow aerial pull-back from the salted plain to a horizon of circling dragons under a red sky.

episodes.title: The Freehold
episodes.era: Valyria at its height — sorcery, Valyrian steel, dragonroads, the mines
episodes.hookOut: Every empire mistakes its peak for its permanence.

scenes.vo: At its height, Valyria ruled from the far east to the narrow sea, and answered to no one.
scenes.shot: Vast aerial at dawn over marble cities, aqueducts and volcanic peaks, dragons distant against a pale sky.

scenes.vo: It called itself a freehold, not an empire. Any freeborn landholder had a voice.
scenes.shot: Interior of a domed marble assembly: hundreds of silver-haired figures arguing on tiered benches, no throne anywhere in frame.

scenes.vo: The word freeborn was doing a great deal of work in that sentence.
scenes.shot: Slow pan from the polished assembly floor down through a grate to a torchlit tunnel of chained workers beneath it.

scenes.vo: Their sorcerers built with fire and stone fused together, and left no seams for us to study.
scenes.shot: Push in on a colossal seamless black stone wall; the surface is glassy and jointless, reflecting torchlight.

scenes.vo: Their ships carried their language, their gods, and their prices to every coast worth reaching.
scenes.shot: Busy harbour at golden hour: ranked galleys unloading crates, clerks tallying, a slave column boarding a hull.

scenes.vo: Nothing threatened them. So they stopped watching the mountains that had made them.
scenes.shot: Wide static on the Fourteen Flames at dusk, thin smoke rising from every summit; a single figure on a balcony turns away from the view.

scenes.vo: Meanwhile, in the west, another people were loading their ships.
scenes.shot: Cut to a cold rocky shore across the sea: bearded men in mail loading longships, seven-pointed stars carved into the prows.

scenes.vo: Every empire mistakes its peak for its permanence. Valyria had four hundred years left.
scenes.shot: Return to the assembly dome, camera craning up past it to the smoking volcanoes behind.

episodes.title: The Andal Tide
episodes.era: Andals cross the narrow sea; the Faith; the fall of the First Men kingdoms
episodes.hookOut: One kingdom in the North never bent. One kingdom in the south was still to come.

scenes.vo: Six thousand years ago, Westeros was invaded again — and this time it stuck.
scenes.shot: Aerial over a fleet of longships crossing a grey sea toward a green coastline at dawn.

scenes.vo: The Andals came out of the east with iron, and iron beats bronze every single time.
scenes.shot: Close combat: an iron blade shears through a bronze sword and the bronze buckles; the bearer falls back.

scenes.vo: They also came with a new religion, and they did not consider it optional.
scenes.shot: A hillside baptism at dawn: robed septons marking foreheads with oil before a seven-pointed star raised on a pole.

scenes.vo: Where they landed, the weirwoods came down and the old gods went quiet.
scenes.shot: Axes at the base of a carved white tree; the face is hacked away before the trunk falls into a cleared grove.

scenes.vo: Kingdom by kingdom, the First Men lost the south. Marriage where it worked, slaughter where it did not.
scenes.shot: Two shots in one move: a formal wedding in a hall, camera trucks right through a doorway into a burning yard of bodies.

scenes.vo: Six kingdoms fell or converted. The seventh looked at the Neck and decided not to bother.
scenes.shot: Wide on a foggy causeway through endless bog; an armoured column halts at the water's edge and turns back.

scenes.vo: The North kept its trees, its gods, and its grudge. It kept all three for six thousand years.
scenes.shot: Slow push in on a snow-covered weirwood in a northern grove, red leaves against grey sky, an armed man kneeling beneath it.

scenes.vo: Six kingdoms, and one that would not bend. The seventh had not been invented yet — and it was coming by sea.
scenes.shot: Cut to a river delta far to the east: an immense fleet of small ships massing at dusk under an unfamiliar banner.

episodes.title: Ten Thousand Ships
episodes.era: The Rhoynar wars, Garin's curse, Nymeria's crossing, the birth of Dorne
episodes.hookOut: Valyria had won again. It had one century left.

scenes.vo: The Rhoynar lived along the greatest river in the world, and they had done it for a very long time.
scenes.shot: Aerial along an immense slow river at golden hour, terraced water-cities and painted boats crowding both banks.

scenes.vo: They were traders, not conquerors, and their water wizards kept their cities from ever being taken.
scenes.shot: River-level shot: robed figures raise their hands and the river visibly swells against a stone wall, holding it.

scenes.vo: Then Valyria wanted their trade routes, and being peaceful stopped being an option.
scenes.shot: Wide on dragons crossing the river at low altitude while painted barges scatter beneath them.

scenes.vo: Prince Garin raised a quarter of a million men. It was the largest army the Rhoyne had ever seen.
scenes.shot: Enormous ground-level tracking shot down a river bank packed with assembled spearmen stretching past the horizon.

scenes.vo: Valyria burned it in an afternoon, then hung him in a golden cage above his own city.
scenes.shot: A gilded cage suspended from a high stone arch above a smoking city; a figure inside watches the water below.

scenes.vo: He cursed them from that cage. Within days the river rose and swallowed the city whole.
scenes.shot: Flooding shot: dark water climbing marble steps, palaces sinking, mist closing over rooftops until nothing is left.

scenes.vo: One princess refused to die there. Nymeria loaded ten thousand ships and sailed west with the survivors.
scenes.shot: Aerial over a colossal ragged fleet at dawn, decks crowded with people, sails patched, all pointed the same way.

scenes.vo: She burned the ships on a desert shore so no one could go back. Out of that came Dorne.
scenes.shot: Night: the entire fleet burning on a dark shoreline, a woman standing on the sand watching, back to camera.

episodes.title: The Dream of Fire
episodes.era: Daenys the Dreamer; House Targaryen sells up and sails to Dragonstone
episodes.hookOut: Their neighbours laughed. Twelve years remained.

scenes.vo: Of the forty dragonlord families of Valyria, House Targaryen was not important.
scenes.shot: Interior of a lamplit marble hall, a modest household of silver-haired figures at a long table, the room plainly smaller than its neighbours.

scenes.vo: They were rich enough, old enough, and nowhere near the top of anyone's list.
scenes.shot: Slow pan across a wall of ancestral busts, the Targaryen name plate small and set to one side among far grander ones.

scenes.vo: Then a daughter of the house began dreaming the same thing, night after night.
scenes.shot: A young woman wakes in the dark, sits up sharply and stares at nothing, breathing hard, sweat on her face.

scenes.vo: She dreamed Valyria burning. Not a battle — the land itself coming apart.
scenes.shot: Dream imagery: marble towers cracking as fire opens along the ground beneath them, all in silence.

scenes.vo: Her father believed her. That decision is the only reason any dragon survived.
scenes.shot: The father listens without interrupting at a table by candlelight, then rises and starts giving orders to servants.

scenes.vo: He sold everything the family owned in Valyria and bought a rock in the narrow sea.
scenes.shot: Clerks stamping deeds; wagons loaded in a courtyard; a bare volcanic island shown on an unrolled sea chart.

scenes.vo: Neighbours called it cowardice. Kin called it madness. They sailed anyway, with their dragons.
scenes.shot: Departure at dawn: loaded ships pulling away from a marble harbour while figures on the quay watch and turn away.

scenes.vo: They reached a black castle on a smoking island at the edge of the world. Twelve years remained.
scenes.shot: Aerial approach to a black stone fortress on a bare volcanic island under low cloud, dragons circling the towers.

episodes.title: The Doom
episodes.era: The Doom of Valyria; the Century of Blood; one small family on one small rock
episodes.hookOut: The last dragonlords in the world were now a single household.

scenes.vo: For twelve years, nothing happened. Valyria traded, built, and quietly forgot the warning.
scenes.shot: Busy Valyrian street at midday, ordinary commerce, no tension anywhere in the frame.

scenes.vo: Then, on one morning, every one of the fourteen volcanoes went up at the same time.
scenes.shot: Static wide on the mountain range as fourteen columns of fire and ash erupt simultaneously into a clear sky.

scenes.vo: The peninsula cracked apart. Hills exploded. The sea came in through the wounds.
scenes.shot: The landmass fracturing along glowing lines; a marble city slides into a widening chasm as seawater floods in.

scenes.vo: Dragons died in the air. Sorcerers died mid-word. It took less than a day.
scenes.shot: Ash-choked sky, burning shapes falling; a robed figure with hands raised is engulfed mid-gesture.

scenes.vo: The greatest civilisation men had built was gone, and it left no one behind who understood it.
scenes.shot: Aerial over a drowned smoking archipelago where a continent used to be, wrecked stone under shallow water.

scenes.vo: What followed was a hundred years of everyone taking what they could reach.
scenes.shot: Rapid succession: mercenary companies on the march, sacked cities, slave columns, burning ports.

scenes.vo: Free cities fought free cities. Old empires dug themselves back up. Nobody ruled anything for long.
scenes.shot: Map-like aerial of the eastern coast with fleets and armies moving against each other in every direction.

scenes.vo: And on one small island in the west, the last dragonlords in the world sat down to plan.
scenes.shot: Slow push through a black stone hall to a huge carved table shaped like a continent, a figure standing over it.
